work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CLXXVII grants the canons of the collegiate church of Saint Nicholas at Andria the rochet, cappa and violet mozzetta with stated fur trimming, collar and stockings; Haec concedimus, Non obstantibus and the full 18 September 1832 closing at Santa Maria Maggiore end at LF28633, immediately before the new numeral CLXXVIII at LF28636. Its note 1 (Ex Bullario Romano) is printed at LF28666 at the foot of the page. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF28529–28529; the source closing at LF28630–28633 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima octava septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno secundo, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
